consequence.statement: The release note only announces a new capability for HelmRelease creation; it describes no failure, rejection, ignored setting, permission change, or altered behaviour for existing configurations, so an operator who does nothing simply gains the new option.
consequence.remediation: Operators wanting a custom storage namespace for new HelmReleases can use the new capability; nothing must be done otherwise.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for specifying a custom storage namespace when creating a HelmRelease; the release note does not name the flag or field that implements this capability.

decision.reason: [ev-19ebf0fc97cf] is a CLI changelog line that only says support was added for a custom storage namespace when creating a HelmRelease. Nothing in it says that existing configurations fail, are rejected, are ignored or behave differently. An operator who does nothing just doesn't use the new opt-in capability, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the "no impact" conclusion is inferred from the additive wording; the note does not state it outright.
